title: Summoning and piloting UAP through meditative states

tellings.quote: What is real is is the ability to go into something like a meditative state and summon UAP

plain: People can go into a meditative state and summon UAP, the government's term for UFOs, and perhaps even guide them. Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he took part in this kind of work, insists that this ability "is real".
